name: Being Restored
overview: Scripture reveals that being restored is a gracious work of the LORD who, as our Shepherd, provides for and revives His people. Restoration encompasses the renewal of joy in salvation, healing from deep wounds, and revival from great troubles, as seen in the pleas of David and the promises given to Zion. God’s restoration is abundant and double in measure, bringing everlasting joy and reclaiming what was lost or consumed, demonstrating His power to renew both heart and circumstance.
